nights.title: Bleech 9:3
nights.name: Bleech 9:3
nights.extract: Bleech 9:3 are an Irish rock band from Dublin. Formed in 2022, its founding lineup was brothers and former JaVill members Barry "Baz" Quinlan and James Quinlan (bass), alongside Basht. members Sam Duffy (guitar) and Luke O'Neill (drums). In 2024, they relocated to London, then released a string of singles beginning in October 2025. They quickly gained commercial attention following a string of international headline tour dates and slots supporting bands in the Windmill scene. They have been noted by publications including The Guardian, Official Charts and BBC as one of the fastest growing rock bands of the mid-2020s. In April 2026, they signed to Polydor Records, who released their self-titled debut EP the same month.
